facts.fact: Audre Lorde's poem 'Father Son and Holy Ghost' begins with the line 'I have not ever seen my father's grave.'
The poem reflects on themes of memory, loss, and familial relationships.
Audre Lorde was born on February 18, 1934, and died on November 17, 1992.
'Father Son and Holy Ghost' is included in the 'Collected Poems of Audre Lorde' published in 1997.

result.summary: Audre Lorde's poem 'Father Son and Holy Ghost' explores themes of memory and loss, starting with the line about never having seen her father's grave. Lorde, a prominent writer and activist, was born in 1934 and passed away in 1992. This poem is part of her collected works published in 1997.

sources.title: Father Son and Holy Ghost | The Poetry Foundation
sources.snippet:
pulls up the grass his stillness grows

calling it weed.

Each week    a different woman

has my mother’s face

and he

who time has    changeless

must be amazed

who knew and loved

but one.

My father died in silence

loving creation

and well-defined response

he lived    still judgments

on familiar things

and died    knowing

a January 15th that year me.

Lest I go into dust

I have not ever seen my father’s grave.
